title: Cosmic Fox Spirit
description: A stylized anthropomorphic fox with white and purple striped fur sits on a rocky mesa. It has long flowing multicolored hair, closed eyes, and a calm expression while purple and black ethereal smoke with floating feathers swirls from its back against a cosmic night sky.
